subject: Invoice & Billing Contact: Portal vs Email copies
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme-corp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Billing preference + PO attached

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Finance asked me to confirm how Redwood will send invoices going forward. We have a PO on file (attached) and prefer invoices to be dropped into our billing portal for automatic matching, but our AP team also asks for a PDF copy by email to billing@acme-corp.com for manual reconciliation in a few cases.

Two quick questions:
- Can you deliver invoices to our portal (https://billing.acme-corp.com) and also CC billing@acme-corp.com?
- Do invoices include a VAT/tax ID line? Our records need Redwood's US EIN and the VAT field (if applicable).

I've attached the PO (Acme_PO_99342.pdf). Outlook sometimes strips long links — happy to jump on a 15-min call if it's easier.

Thanks,
Sara Lopez\Senior Procurement Specialist\Acme Corp

Attachments: Acme_PO_99342.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Billing preference + PO attached

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the PO and the clear notes. Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can push invoices into your portal (SFTP/API/portal drop) and also send a PDF copy to billing@acme-corp.com.
- Our invoices include a tax section; I'll confirm the exact tax IDs on the invoice header.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll ask our Billing team to create a one-off invoice for the attached PO and include Redwood's tax/EIN info.
2) We will test portal delivery for that invoice and simultaneously CC billing@acme-corp.com.
3) If your AP needs a different filename or reference format (e.g., PO-first, client-account), tell me and we will adapt.

Looping in Marissa from Billing and Sean from Sales Ops to own the invoice generation and portal setup. Marissa — can you take point on the draft invoice and confirm the tax/EIN lines? Sean — please create the HubSpot billing note and link the PO to deal RDW-2026-ACME-57.

I'll follow up once Marissa posts the draft.

Best,
Jordan Blake\Head of Commercial Ops\Redwood Inference\(415) 555-0134

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Billing preference + PO attached -- Draft invoice attached

Jordan / Sara —

Attached is Draft_Invoice_20270210_RDW-57.pdf. Notes:
- Invoice header includes Redwood Inference, EIN: 12-3456789, and a Tax ID field labeled VAT/Tax with a blank when not applicable for US customers.
- Filename currently: Draft_Invoice_20270210_RDW-57.pdf — if Acme wants PO-first, we can rename to 99342_RDW-Invoice.pdf.
- Delivery: we can POST the final PDF to your portal endpoint (SFTP or API). For testing, I can also email billing@acme-corp.com and confirm receipt.

Sara: please confirm preferred delivery method (Portal API vs SFTP vs Email drop) and whether the filename schema needs to change. Once you confirm, we will finalize and issue.

Attachments: Draft_Invoice_20270210_RDW-57.pdf, SOW_Q1-2027_Acme.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole\Billing Manager\Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, billing@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: Portal delivery tested + email copy to AP (confirming)

Sara —

Thanks for the quick replies. Final status:
- Marissa tested portal delivery using Acme's API endpoint and confirmed a successful POST.
- A copy of the finalized invoice (Invoice_20270211_RDW-57.pdf) will be POSTed to https://billing.acme-corp.com/api/invoices and an identical PDF emailed to billing@acme-corp.com for your team's backup.
- Invoice header includes: Redwood Inference, EIN: 12-3456789, VAT/Tax ID: N/A (US customer). If Acme requires Redwood to populate a specific VAT code, tell us which field to place it in.

Action items for Acme:
- Sara or billing: confirm whether the invoice filename should start with the PO number (99342) or with our invoice number (Invoice_20270211_RDW-57).
- Confirm any additional fields you need in the JSON metadata when we POST (e.g., cost-center, GL-code).

If all good, Marissa will mark the invoice as final and schedule monthly deliveries into your portal for future invoices.

Thanks everyone — feel free to reply-all with the confirmation and I'll close out the HubSpot task.

Best,
Jordan
